places-hoyos-ii-abrigo-de-los-gavilanes.story: From Velez Rubio it runs 71 km to Velez Rubio; allow about 1 h 13 of riding. It goes by way of Gabar, Abrigo de los Gavilanes and back through Gabar. The highest point is about 1,200 m. It was put together for the scenery rather than the shortest line.

legend-furka-grimsel-susten-pass-loop.story: A alpine pass loop based around Andermatt, Switzerland, via Furka Pass. Key character: glaciers; hairpins; high passes. Surface: paved.

scenicChapters.title: Furka Pass
scenicChapters.narrative: Expect company on a summer weekend. Early is better than fast. For 15 km this is Furka Pass, a road with a name of its own and a reason for it.
scenicChapters.riderNote: Check the pass is open before you commit to it.

legend-vidzeme-seacoast-road.story: The Gulf of Riga shore north-east from the city: pine, sand and fishing villages, with the sea on your left the whole way to the Estonian border.

scenicChapters.title: Vidzeme Seacoast Road
scenicChapters.narrative: Slow enough to look. The surface follows the shoreline, so the corners arrive where the water decided, not where an engineer did. Water arrives beside the road and stays for 12 km. The line follows the shore because there is nowhere else for it to go.
